standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: Gemma, how do you feel about sport?
entries.zh: 杰玛，你觉得运动怎么样？

entries.en: I’m not interested in sport.
entries.zh: 我对运动不感兴趣。

entries.en: I really don’t like it.
entries.zh: 我真的不喜欢。

entries.en: I mean, I like exercise so I go for walks and I like swimming, oh I run a lot too, that’s great – but I just don’t like sport, you know, the idea where you try to win, to beat other people.
entries.zh: 我是说，我喜欢锻炼，所以我去散步，也喜欢游泳，哦，我还经常跑步，那很棒——但我就是不喜欢运动，你知道的，那种要赢、要打败别人的运动。

entries.en: And I hate sport on TV – I leave the room!
entries.zh: 而且我讨厌电视上的体育节目——我会离开房间！

entries.en: And I don’t go to sports events like football matches – why do people pay so much money to watch 22 men run after a ball?
entries.zh: 我也不去看足球比赛那样的体育赛事——为什么人们要花那么多钱看 22 个人追着一个球跑？

entries.en: Andy, how do you feel about sport?
entries.zh: 安迪，你觉得运动怎么样？

entries.en: Well, I like running a lot.
entries.zh: 嗯，我非常喜欢跑步。

entries.en: At school I play football but that’s because I have to, all the boys play football, and it’s OK, I mean I don’t hate it, but I don’t really like team games and sports very much.
entries.zh: 在学校我踢足球，但那是因为我不得不踢，所有男孩都踢足球，还行吧，我是说我不讨厌它，但我不太喜欢团队运动和体育。

entries.en: I like doing things alone and I think that’s why I love running, it’s just me and not other people.
entries.zh: 我喜欢一个人做事，我想这就是我喜欢跑步的原因，只有我自己，没有别人。

entries.en: I’m not a very good runner but I just love trying to run a little faster than the last time, do you know what I mean?
entries.zh: 我跑得不是很好，但我就是喜欢试着比上一次跑快一点点，你明白我的意思吗？

entries.en: Tracey, how do you feel about sport?
entries.zh: 特蕾西，你觉得运动怎么样？

entries.en: Well, I absolutely love skateboarding, of course!
entries.zh: 嗯，我当然非常喜欢滑板！

entries.en: It’s just the best thing in the world.
entries.zh: 那是世界上最好的事情。

entries.en: Some of my family say it isn’t really a sport but they don’t know anything.
entries.zh: 我家里有些人说滑板不算真正的运动，但他们什么都不懂。

entries.en: I spend hours practising moves.
entries.zh: 我花好几个小时练习动作。

entries.en: There’s a skate-park with a really good ramp, it’s not far from where I live.
entries.zh: 有一个滑板公园，坡道特别好，离我家不远。

entries.en: I’m there all the time.
entries.zh: 我一直待在那里。

entries.en: It’s the only sport I like really.
entries.zh: 这真的是我唯一喜欢的运动。

entries.en: I mean, I kind of like football but really that’s only because some of my friends are into it.
entries.zh: 我是说，我有点喜欢足球，但那只是因为我的一些朋友喜欢。

entries.en: But skateboarding, that’s my thing.
entries.zh: 但滑板才是我的热爱。

entries.en: Paul, how do you feel about sport?
entries.zh: 保罗，你觉得运动怎么样？

entries.en: When I was a kid I didn’t like any sports at all.
entries.zh: 我小时候一点也不喜欢运动。

entries.en: I thought: ‘I’m just not good at things like running and jumping’ but about a year ago I saw some gymnastics on TV and now I love it.
entries.zh: 我以前想：“我就是不擅长跑步和跳跃之类的事”，但大约一年前我在电视上看到体操，现在我爱上了它。

entries.en: There’s a sports centre in my town where I can do gymnastics.
entries.zh: 我住的镇上有个体育中心，我可以在那里练体操。

entries.en: I can’t do it at school because they haven’t got anywhere, but I go to the sports centre every weekend and some evenings too, to do as much gymnastics as I can.
entries.zh: 学校里没有地方练，但我每个周末和一些晚上都会去体育中心，尽可能多地练体操。

entries.en: Ryan, how do you feel about sport?
entries.zh: 瑞安，你觉得运动怎么样？

entries.en: Sport? Wonderful!
entries.zh: 运动？太棒了！

entries.en: I’m a real sports fanatic.
entries.zh: 我是个真正的体育迷。

entries.en: I mean, I think about sport all the time.
entries.zh: 我是说，我一直在想运动。

entries.en: I watch almost everything on TV – football, tennis, swimming, everything.
entries.zh: 电视上的体育节目我几乎都看——足球、网球、游泳，什么都看。

entries.en: And I do a lot of sport too – my favourite’s football, of course, and I’m really not bad at football.
entries.zh: 我也做很多运动——当然，我最喜欢足球，而且我踢得真不错。

entries.en: I’m in the school team too.
entries.zh: 我也是校队成员。

entries.en: And I’m also learning to ski.
entries.zh: 而且我还在学滑雪。

entries.en: My family went to Italy last year.
entries.zh: 去年我们全家去了意大利。

entries.en: We went skiing – it was fantastic and I want to do more.
entries.zh: 我们去滑雪了——太棒了，我还想再去。
